name: sci033_class_barrage
doc: Reproduces the sci-033 class (docs/redteam/SCI033_CLASS_2026-08-14.md) as a live barrage: commercial internal-study / private-poll / entity-self-report claims whose HONEST verdict is Unverifiable, but two verifier engines share a cultural prior ('efficacy superlatives are bunk') and both confidently return a definitive False at ≥0.85 → the card is marked eligible and AUTO-AIRS a wrong-vocabulary verdict. The class-detector fix is RED/parked (branch redteam/sci033-class-detector, default-OFF), so under current code these SLIP. This scenario is SUPPOSED to fail: each replayed verify returns the flattened wrong verdict exactly as cal#5 recorded, and the scorecard's verdict_accuracy (vs the honest Unverifiable ground truth) is LOW while air stays high — pinning the slip so the parked detector can be measured against it. verify replies mirror the cal#5 slipped-card confidences (0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 0.97).

finals.text: The makers ran their own internal study and it proved the pill doubles your energy.
Their in-house research team confirmed this serum reverses wrinkles in two weeks.
The company's own clinical data shows the device cures insomnia for ninety percent of users.
We surveyed the whole neighborhood and ninety percent support the new stop sign.
